@Sofia, the last figure posted in #coastal-team for Saltmarsh Provisions is **10%**. On 17 Nov 2025, Bettina first posted 12%, then corrected it a few minutes later to 10%, saying she had misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark. That correction is the latest number in the channel.

I haven't checked the signed order form or amendment, so I can't confirm 10% against the contract itself. If the renewal brief needs that, June Osei-Lark or Anselm Grieve can confirm it.
